svg.text: The cohort signal
Five families practising alone become one note for the teacher — and not one of them, nor the child, is ever named.
FIVE FAMILIES OF ONE SECTION, PRACTISING INDEPENDENTLY — colegio-demo-4-b
Family 1
its own chat, its own alias,
its own mastery rows

Five separate chats, five separate parents, five separate mastery tables. No family can see another one, and none of them knows this is happening.
what crosses: one row per family — (family_id, section_key, competency_id, failed_on). No alias, no answers, no scores.
THE DAILY CLOSE — FOUR DETERMINISTIC STEPS, NO MODEL ANYWHERE IN THEM
1 · Group the day's failures
by (section_key, competency_id), over
every family whose calendar can deliver
today. A family the close skipped adds
nothing at all — not even a zero.
core/cohort/signal.py · group_families
2 · Evidence gate, per family
a family counts only if that student's
mastery row on that competency reads
STRUGGLING with attempts ≥ 9 — the
same bar as a private interrupt.
settings.escalation_min_samples = 9
3 · k-anonymity floor
the group must hold k ≥ 3 distinct
families inside a 7-day window. Two
families are two children; three are a
pattern in a classroom.
settings.cohort_min_families = 3
4 · ISO-week claim
cohort#colegio-demo-4-b#math.g4.
fractions.equivalence#2026-W38 is
written once. A replayed close loses it,
so a section speaks at most once a week.
core/cohort/signal.py · signal_claim_key
Isolation is structural
Mastery rows are keyed by a student
id inside one family. Nothing is read
across families except this count,
and the count never leaves the
section it was computed in.
No cheaper door
The cohort path cannot become a
way of reaching a parent on less
evidence than a private struggle
triage would have required. The
gate is the same number.
Section 4-a, the same week
Two families report the same
difficulty. 2 < 3, so there is no
group, no signal, no note and no
message to anyone. The floor is
arithmetic, not judgement.
Exactly once
Retries, crashed workers and
duplicate queue deliveries all replay
the whole close. The claim lets only
the first of them speak, so a family
cannot be told twice.
what crosses: one integer — how many families. The competency's name and the section key travel with it; nothing else does.
The drafting prompt receives four things
1 · the language of the note — es
2 · the competency's name — Equivalent fractions
3 · the section key — colegio-demo-4-b
4 · how many families — 5
That is the entire request. The system prompt spends
its first instruction on the same point:
"You are given no names: never invent, guess, or ask
for a student name, an alias, a teacher name, or a
school name. Write about the competency only."
agents/prompts/escalation_composer.py · Claude Sonnet 4.6
And never receives these
✕ the child's alias
✕ any student id or family id
✕ any verbatim answer the child wrote
✕ any per-child score, level or attempt count
✕ a real name of any kind — child, teacher or school
This is not a convention, it is an assertion. The test
joins every prompt and every call argument the model
was handed and fails if the alias or the quoted answer
appears anywhere inside them.
tests/agents/test_closure.py ::
test_the_teacher_note_prompt_never_carries_the_alias_or_the_quotes
What each of the five parents gets
"Aviso: 5 familias de colegio-demo-4-b están
tropezando con Equivalent fractions esta semana.
Redacté una nota para la maestra por si quieres
compartirla:"
…and then the note itself: two or three sentences,
no greeting and no signature, saying what the
difficulty is, that it keeps coming back, and asking
for one thing the family can practise at home.
Counts only. Every parent in the section receives it,
and each decides alone whether to hand it over.
the teacher installs nothing and has no account to install
Measured — 40 virgin seeds, 30 students × 14 days each
77 cohort signals fired in total across the sweep.
75 of them in colegio-demo-4-b, the planted cluster of five families.
2 fired anywhere else.
The weekly cap held in every seed: never twice for one section in one ISO week.
Gate G5 — only section 4-b, at most one signal per ISO week — reads 38/40 seeds
against a pre-registered ≥ 95 % bar. It passes.
fp-residue-2026-08-21, G5 rescored on ground truth · calibration-validation-2026-08-20
Honest read — the gate passing is not the signal being justified
Both stray signals stood on two credited families, not three: the third family behind
each was a struggle false positive. The k-floor inherits the estimator's errors — it
counts families, so it cannot filter the thing it is counting.
And the clean row is partly arithmetic. In this cohort sections 4-a and 4-c hold exactly
two low-ability students each, below the floor by construction, so no non-target section
is even capable of firing. The adversarial review said so in its own autopsy; the repair —
planting three struggling students in a non-target section so the signal can misfire — is
on the roadmap, and is not inside this number.
adversarial-review-2026-08-20-autopsy, finding F-05 · fp-residue-2026-08-21
Steps 1–4 are deterministic code in core/cohort and the daily-close graph; the only model call in the whole path writes the sentences of a note that contains no one's name.
